title: Corrupt Prompt Metadata IPFS Hash Mismatch
description: The SHA-256 prompt hash recorded on Stellar ledger does not match the metadata CID pinned on IPFS.
repairInstructions: Run `npx ts-node src/scripts/repairMetadataHash.ts --prompt-id prompt-892a` or invoke `fixtureRepairManager.repairMetadataHash()` to re-calculate metadata hash and update Stellar memo reference.

title: Orphaned Pending Buyer Escrow
description: Stellar escrow transaction stuck in pending status after buyer payment attempt timed out.
repairInstructions: Execute `fixtureRepairManager.repairOrphanedEscrow('escrow-992b')` to issue an automatic Stellar refund to the buyer account.

title: Desynced Prompt Version Ledger State
description: Local creator prompt version state is desynchronized from Stellar Horizon ledger version sequence.
repairInstructions: Run `fixtureRepairManager.syncPromptLedgerVersion('prompt-v42')` to fetch latest Horizon ledger sequence and update local state.
